feature_interpretation: Empirical geometry-motivated basis, not a validated physical law or identified gravity relation. 19 is a fixed centering constant, not an extinction threshold.
retransformation: Unsmoothed output is exp(predicted log rate), a geometric-scale point prediction; not necessarily a conditional median or arithmetic mean. Smearing variant multiplies by the training-group-weighted mean exp(in-sample log residual). A single smear factor assumes an applicable residual distribution, and is not guaranteed conditionally unbiased under heteroscedasticity or domain shift.
weights_and_scaling: Same training-only group weights and weighted standardization as Round 1. No held-out labels enter transforms or smearing.
comparison: Reuse immutable Round 1 predictions and exact splits for median, nearest, raw ridge, raw GPU CatBoost. Report all four new variants. No model selection, parameter tuning or early stopping inside this round.
primary_metric: Equal-group MAE in mm/s; secondary group RMSE and row R2.
progress_gate: A variant advances on within-domain development evidence only if group MAE beats Round 1 ridge in BOTH Earth and full flight evaluations. Report strict-unit sensitivity separately, never as a clean same-population comparison.
transfer_gate: At least 20% lower group MAE than Round 1 nearest baseline on all 34 flight transfer rows (threshold 0.8 times the full-precision recorded baseline). Also report error changes vs raw ridge and CatBoost; do not substitute a filtered subset for primary scores.
error_analysis: 2000 paired group bootstrap resamples, seed20261114, model-minus-reference MAE; descriptive only, not calibrated prediction intervals or confirmatory p-values. Show in/out marginal training box counts and scores as descriptive subgroups; do not claim an abstention policy is validated.
readiness: No agreed task-based absolute-error requirement, calibrated intervals or genuinely independent lunar test. Improved scores alone cannot mark the ML hackathon-ready for a lunar claim.
adaptive_reuse: Round 2 is informed by seen Round 1 test outcomes. Reusing folds makes this development evaluation, not a fresh blind validation. Hold future independent evidence for confirmation.
mixed_velocity_check: Link2018 full text and PDF p7 describe mixed convection and roughly30 cm/s buoyancy, but no explicit effective-velocity/gravity mapping was found. Do not implement an attributed formula, add a fixed30 cm/s, or learn a lunar correction from these texts.
excluded: claims that Earth tests mislead engineers
stop: Finish these fixed comparisons and verification, publish every result, then stop for user review. No automatic Round 3. Repeated reuse of these folds is not new validation. If gain fails, prefer source repair/compatible data to unbounded tuning.
